Otherwise, execution will be forcibly terminated."<FC:B4:3E>
Touya: "...There's nobody here."
Yamato: "Hmm..."
Melvi: "Huh? Big brother...?"
Touya: "Huh? Where are you?"
Yamato: "Touya, look up! It looks like she was
inside Forstin."
Melvi: "Big brotheeer!"
Touya: "Hey! It's dangerous to lean out that far!"
Melvi: "I'm fi... Oh! W-Whoa, whoa, whoa..."
Touya: "M-Melvi!"
Melvi: "Aaaaaaah?!"
Yamato: "Nice catch!"
Melvi: "Aaaaah! I'm falling!"
Touya: "H-Hey... Melvi?"
Melvi: "Aaaaah! Aaaaah!"
Touya: "Calm down. You're safe now."
Melvi: "Huh...? Oh, whaaat?"
Touya: "...Jeez. Did you really have to go
and fall off? I thought my heart was gonna stop..."
Melvi: "Y-Yeah... I'm sorry..."
Touya: "Huh?"
Touya: "W-What's wrong? Are you hurt anywhere?"
Melvi: "N-No. That's not it. I'm okay.
U-Um... Thank you, big brother."
Touya: "S-Sure. Can you stand?"
Melvi: "Yeah."
Touya: "Ow, ow, ow..."
Yamato: "Hey, are you all right?"
Melvi: "I-I'm sorry...
It's because I fell on you..."
Touya: "Don't worry. I only hurt myself a little.
I'm just glad you weren't hurt."
Melvi: "Y-Yeah..."
Touya: "Don't look so worried. I'm really okay.
See? Look!"
Melvi: "Wow, that's amazing!"
Yamato: "...We can tell without you waving your arms around so much."
Melvi: "...I'm glad."
Touya: "Don't do anything like that again, okay?"
Melvi: "Okay!"
Touya: "...So, what were you doing
inside Forstin?"
Melvi: "I'm still not very good, so I asked Celica
to let me practise."
Touya: "Huh. Good for you."
Melvi: "Hee hee hee."
Touya: "Looks like we interrupted you."
Melvi: "No, not at all.
I like talking with you, big brother."
Touya: "Yeah? Still, we shouldn't get in the way of your
practice. We'd better get going."
Melvi: "Huh? O-Okay. See you, then!"
Touya: "Don't fall over!"
Melvi: "Okay!"
Yamato: "...Melvi's working hard to catch up too."
Touya: "Yeah... But she's only twelve, right?
Do people in this world learn to pilot at that age?"
Yamato: "Who knows?"
Gabon: "...That kid's special."
Touya: "Whoa?!"
Yamato: "...Special?"
Gabon: "There are a fair number who can get an Armored Mech moving
at her age. But mastering one is
another matter. Her natural ability is outstanding."
Yamato: "And she works hard too."
Gabon: "Yeah. If anyone deserves to be called a genius,
I'd say it's her."
Touya: "She's that good?"
Gabon: "Some exceptional Pilots can talk with their mechs.
But that kid can trade jokes with hers...
Well, that's one way of putting it."
Touya: "...I don't really get it."
Gabon: "It means she can sense and take in more than ordinary people,
and give more back in return."
Touya: "O-Oh..."
Gabon: "...Well, you'd better work hard too,
or she'll overtake you."
Touya: "Mind your own business!"
Gabon: "Gwa ha ha ha ha ha! See you."
Yamato: "Melvi may have amazing talent, but...
it's so sad that a child her age
has to fight."
Touya: "Yeah. That's another reason we need to end this soon..."
Yamato: "Huh? The elevator's moving. That's unusual.
I wonder if someone's inside."
Touya: "Well, people do use it."
Yamato: "But whenever I see it, it's stopped.
Right on the floor I'm on, too."
Touya: "You're imagining it. You're imagining it. Anyway..."
Yamato: "Oh, it stopped."
Fain: "Ha ha ha ha ha ha!
To protect those I love, my blade of justice strikes the foe!
My crimson blood burns red! This is the way a man must live!
A man of justice and truth!
Faaain, Jiiin, Baaaariooon!!
I have arrived! For justice... I would die!"
Yamato: "..."
Touya: "..."
Fain: "...Huh?"
Yamato: "..."
Touya: "..."
Fain: "Heeey!"
Fain: "H-Hey! Don't ignore me!
I went to all the trouble of waiting for you..."
Touya: "...You need to get Gabon to take a look at you."
Fain: "What?! I'm the very picture of health!
I'm not so feeble that I'd fall ill!
Bwa ha ha ha ha!"
Yamato: "...It's serious."
Fain: "...So, how was it? I'm pretty confident
about this one. Ah, my own talent frightens me."
It was pretty good.
It sounded like enka.
Fain: "Right? Especially the last part. Even I got chills
saying it!"
Yamato: "He's drunk on himself... It's terminal."
Touya: "R-Right. Well, keep at it."
Fain: "'Enka'? What's that?"
Yamato: "Hmm... You could call it 'the song
of the Japanese heart,' I guess."
Fain: "The heart? So you mean a song that speaks
directly to the soul?"
Yamato: "W-Well, something like that."
Fain: "Oh! Then that means my introduction
is just as magnificent!"
Yamato: "Y-Yeah... Maybe..."
Fain: "Bwa ha ha ha ha! You understand!"
Yamato: "By the way, Fain, how come you're always
so single-minded?"
Fain: "Heh heh heh... Because I believe in justice!
To die for it would be my greatest wish!
And that justice also protects those dear to me!"
Touya: "Huh. Those dear to you, eh...?"
Fain: "Yes! For the princess, and for Ymir,
and for K-Kasumi... No! My justice is not so
fickle! Oh, what am I supposed to do...?"
Yamato: "...What do we do?"
Touya: "We'd better keep our distance..."
Fain: "Come on, we're friends!
Tell me, who should I fight for?
I have vowed in my heart to love just one woman.
Yet I also have the noble and supreme
duty of protecting the princess. I can abandon neither loyalty nor love.
Ah... What a trial! Such is the fate of a knight!
Then I shall press onward! To battle my destiny!
No, wait. My master also said that to desire too much at once
is the same as losing it all.
Does that mean I must commit myself to just one?!
Oh! How can this be?!
And to choose between Ymir and Kasumi...
Grr... This is all because of those fiends from ≪Ze=Ode≫...
If it weren't for them, I would never have had
to suffer like thiiis...
Wait! Could this be a conspiracy of theirs?!
Grrrrrr... Damn them... How vile...
No, what a fearsome foe is ≪Ze=Ode≫!!
But I, Fain Jin Barion, will not be discouraged
by such a trifle! Hm? Does that mean
that to turn their plan against them, I must preserve my love for both women
and my loyalty to the princess,
all at the same time?
No, but then I'd be defying my master's teachings.
Aaaaah, what am I supposed to doooo?!!"
Fain: "...Huh? Touya? Heeey..."
Yamato: "...He has his troubles too."
Touya: "Well, he seems happy enough with the way he is.
Anyway, let's go."
Yamato: "Y-Yeah..."
